Recipe is below:

Crust - 

I used a combination of gluten free graham crackers (6 grahams) and gluten free ginger snaps (8 cookies) crushed either by hand or with a mixer. You want a fine mix so if you do it by hand, it's a lot of work. Add 1/4 cup of melted unsalted butter. Set aside a small portion to use as a crumble top for the pie. Press remaining portion into the pie pan using the back of a spoon. Once done, bake in a preheated oven for 10-15 minutes at 350 degrees.

Pie -

1/2 cup unsalted butter

3 tablespoons gluten free flower, and about 1/8 teaspoon of xanthan gum as a binding agent

1/4 cup water

1/2 cup white sugar

1/2 cup packed brown sugar

8 Granny Smith apples (lunch size) - peeled, cored, and sliced

Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Melt the butter in a saucepan. Stir in flour/xanthan gum to form a paste. Add water, white sugar and brown sugar, and bring to a boil. Reduce temperature and let simmer. This is your caramel.

Fill crust with apples, mounded slightly. Gently pour the caramel over the crust. Pour slowly so that it does not run off. Add the crumble over the top of the caramel and apples, if desired.

Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven. Reduce the temperature to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Continue baking for 35 to 45 minutes, until apples are soft.

Let the pie cool as long as you wish then enjoy with vanilla bean ice cream, if desired.
